evidencepack/access-posture@v1./sign_in/sso_configured: Sets true when ListInstances has an active organization instance of IAM Identity Center for the account, or ListRoles or ListSAMLProviders has an AWSReservedSSO_ role or a SAML provider. An account is unknown when the config lists the regions and none of them has an instance, unless a role or SAML provider shows SSO. The total is false when any account is false, left out when any other account is unknown, and true otherwise.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/members_present: Sets true when an account's credential report has a row other than <root_account> whose password_enabled is true, or when sso_member_count is above 0. The total is true when any account has one.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/member_count: Counts the GetCredentialReport rows other than <root_account> whose password_enabled is true. A user with access keys and no console password is a credential, not a member. The total adds up the accounts and adds sso_member_count, and an account's count adds the Identity Center users assigned to that account.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/sso_member_count: Counts the users in ListUsers for the directory of each organization instance of IAM Identity Center that an account can read, each directory once. They are not IAM users, so member_count leaves them out. It is 0 when no account has Identity Center, and people who sign in through a SAML provider an account trusts directly are not counted. It is left out when the config lists the regions and none of them has an instance. An account's value counts the users ListAccountAssignments assigns to that account, directly or through a group in ListGroupMemberships, read from the account that holds the organization instance.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/sso_coverage_pct: Divides sso_member_count by member_count and rounds down.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/local_members_present: Sets true when the credential report has a row other than <root_account> whose password_enabled is true. Every such IAM user can sign in with its own password, so every one counts as local. The total is true when any account has one.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/local_member_count: Counts the GetCredentialReport rows other than <root_account> whose password_enabled is true. A user with access keys and no console password is a credential, not a member. Every such IAM user can sign in with its own password, so every one counts as local.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/local_mfa_member_count: Counts the non-root credential report rows whose password_enabled and mfa_active are true.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/local_mfa_coverage_pct: Divides local_mfa_member_count by local_member_count and rounds down.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/inactive_member_count: Counts the non-root credential report rows whose password_enabled is true and whose password_last_used and access key last used dates are all more than 90 days before the run, or absent. It is left out with a not_read gap when IAM Identity Center users are assigned to the account, or for the total when Identity Center has users, since their sign-ins are in CloudTrail, which the collector does not read.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/inactive_pct: Divides inactive_member_count by member_count and rounds up. It is left out with a not_read gap when IAM Identity Center users are assigned to the account, or for the total when Identity Center has users.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/admins_present: Sets true when there is an IAM user with a console password and one of the AWS managed policies AdministratorAccess, PowerUserAccess or IAMFullAccess in ListAttachedUserPolicies, or in ListAttachedGroupPolicies for one of the user's groups in ListGroupsForUser. With IAM Identity Center users assigned to the account, or for the total in the organization, and no such IAM user, it is left out with a not_read gap. The total is true when any account has one.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/admin_count: Counts each IAM user with a console password and one of the AWS managed policies AdministratorAccess, PowerUserAccess or IAMFullAccess in ListAttachedUserPolicies, or in ListAttachedGroupPolicies for one of the user's groups in ListGroupsForUser. A user with an inline policy, from ListUserPolicies or ListGroupPolicies, or a customer managed policy, and none of those three, leaves the count out with a partial gap, since the collector does not read policy documents. When IAM Identity Center users are assigned to the account, or for the total when Identity Center has users, the count is left out with a not_read gap, since the policies of their permission sets are not evaluated.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/admin_share_pct: Divides admin_count by members.member_count and rounds up.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/local_admins_present: Sets true when there is an IAM user with a console password and one of the AWS managed policies AdministratorAccess, PowerUserAccess or IAMFullAccess in ListAttachedUserPolicies, or in ListAttachedGroupPolicies for one of the user's groups in ListGroupsForUser, since every such IAM user can sign in without SSO.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/local_admin_count: Counts each IAM user with a console password and one of the AWS managed policies AdministratorAccess, PowerUserAccess or IAMFullAccess in ListAttachedUserPolicies, or in ListAttachedGroupPolicies for one of the user's groups in ListGroupsForUser, since every such IAM user can sign in without SSO. A user with an inline policy, from ListUserPolicies or ListGroupPolicies, or a customer managed policy, and none of those three, leaves the count out with a partial gap, since the collector does not read policy documents.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/local_mfa_admin_count: Counts the IAM users in local_admin_count whose credential report row has mfa_active true.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/local_admin_mfa_coverage_pct: Divides local_mfa_admin_count by local_admin_count and rounds down.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./root/root_accounts_present: Sets true for each account collected, since every AWS account has one root user.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./root/root_account_count: Counts one root user for each account collected.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./root/root_mfa_account_count: Counts the accounts whose root user has MFA, or has no password, access key, or signing certificate to sign in with. It reads GetAccountSummary, or the credential report's <root_account> row when that call fails.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./root/root_mfa_coverage_pct: Divides root_mfa_account_count by root_account_count and rounds down.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./root/root_access_keys_present: Sets true when an account's root user has an access key, by AccountAccessKeysPresent in GetAccountSummary or the credential report's <root_account> row when that call fails.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/credentials_present: Sets true when a non-root credential report row has access_key_1_active or access_key_2_active true. The total is true when any account has one.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/credential_count: Counts the active access keys in the non-root credential report rows.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/never_expiring_credential_c: Counts every active access key in credential_count, since AWS access keys have no expiry date.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/never_expiring_pct: Divides never_expiring_credential_count by credential_count and rounds up. It is 100 whenever there is an active access key.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/unused_credential_count: Counts the active access keys whose last used date in the credential report is more than 90 days before the run, or absent.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/unused_pct: Divides unused_credential_count by credential_count and rounds up.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/rotation_overdue_credential: Counts the active access keys whose last rotated date in the credential report is more than 90 days before the run, or absent.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/rotation_overdue_pct: Divides rotation_overdue_credential_count by credential_count and rounds up.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./connected_apps/apps_present: Sets true when a statement of an IAM role's trust policy in ListRoles lets an AWS account outside the organization assume the role without requiring MFA. A statement requires MFA with a Bool condition that aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent is true or a numeric condition on aws:MultiFactorAuthAge, and it lets in people signing in from the other account, not an app. The organization's accounts come from ListAccounts in AWS Organizations, and an account in no organization has none but itself. A service principal, a SAML or OIDC provider, the role's own account, and an account the run collects do not count, and IAM Identity Center applications are not read. It is left out when a role list cannot be read, when a role lets every principal, *, assume it without MFA, since the trust policy's other conditions are not evaluated, or when ListAccounts fails and a role lets another account in without MFA, unless an account known to be outside sets it true.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./connected_apps/app_count: Counts the AWS accounts outside the organization that a statement of an IAM role's trust policy in ListRoles lets assume the role without requiring MFA, each once however many roles in however many accounts trust it. A statement requires MFA with a Bool condition that aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent is true or a numeric condition on aws:MultiFactorAuthAge, and an account that only such statements admit is people signing in, not an app. The organization's accounts come from ListAccounts in AWS Organizations, and an account in no organization has none but itself. A service principal, a SAML or OIDC provider, the role's own account, and an account the run collects do not count, and IAM Identity Center applications are not read. It is left out when a role list cannot be read, when a role lets every principal, *, assume it without MFA, since the trust policy's other conditions are not evaluated, or when ListAccounts fails and a role lets another account in without MFA.

evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/enabled: Sets true when Amazon Inspector and the category's scan type are ENABLED in BatchGetAccountStatus in every region scanned. The scan types are EC2 scanning for hosts, ECR scanning for containers, and Lambda standard scanning for functions.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/resources_present: Sets true when resource_count is above 0. The total is true when any account has resources.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/resource_count: For hosts, counts the running EC2 instances in DescribeInstances, and for functions, the Lambda functions in ListFunctions. For containers, counts the ECR images in ListCoverageStatistics, which has them only where ECR scanning is on.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/scanned_resource_count: Counts the resources of the category whose PACKAGE scan has the status ACTIVE in ListCoverageStatistics. A Lambda function with code scanning on also has a CODE entry, which is not counted. A region where Inspector is off adds none.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/coverage_pct: Divides scanned_resource_count by resource_count and rounds down.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/open_critical_present: Sets true when ListFindings has an ACTIVE finding rated CRITICAL on a resource of the category.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/open_high_present: Sets true when ListFindings has an ACTIVE finding rated HIGH on a resource of the category.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/overdue_present: Sets true when overdue_critical_count or overdue_high_count is above 0 in any region.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/open_critical_count: Counts the ACTIVE findings rated CRITICAL in ListFindings for the account's resources of the category. A region where Inspector is off adds none.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/open_high_count: Counts the ACTIVE findings rated HIGH in ListFindings for the account's resources of the category. A region where Inspector is off adds none.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/open_medium_count: Counts the ACTIVE findings rated MEDIUM in ListFindings for the account's resources of the category. A region where Inspector is off adds none.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/open_low_count: Counts the ACTIVE findings rated LOW in ListFindings for the account's resources of the category. A region where Inspector is off adds none.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/overdue_critical_count: Counts the ACTIVE findings rated CRITICAL whose firstObservedAt is more than 30 days before the run.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/overdue_high_count: Counts the ACTIVE findings rated HIGH whose firstObservedAt is more than 90 days before the run.

evidencepack/cloud-posture@v1./workforce_sign_in/in_use: Sets true when ListInstances has an active organization instance of IAM Identity Center for any account, ListRoles has an AWSReservedSSO_ role, or ListSAMLProviders has the SAML provider Identity Center creates. Sets false when every account's instance and role listings answered and found none.
evidencepack/cloud-posture@v1./workforce_sign_in/user_count: Counts the users ListUsers returns from the identity store of each organization instance the accounts can see, counting each store once.
